text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To recap our investigation so far: it 
appears the intruder slipped in using the 
door at the back of the library that leads 
into the archives.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We will inspect the inside of the storage 
room and uncover any clues, traces of the 
intruder, or anything out of the ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Understood!" "Let's do our best!" 
"Okaaay!" "Leave it to me!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see... The door was hidden behind 
luggage and books, so unless you already 
knew it was there, you'd never notice it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh? There's a rope sticking out from under 
the shelf. 
Suspicious... I'm gonna pull it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh, it won't budge at all... What the 
heck is it tied to~~?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-Windy-san! Please do not pull with 
excessive force!! 
What if you pull the whole shelf down?! 
Let go of it!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
This pile of wooden crates is in the way. 
I'll just shove them all over there at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: One, two... HEEEAVE!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Big-san?! They're going to fall, it's 
dangerous! 
Please carry them one by one!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's something written on the wall! 
Let's see... 
"My pace-reading is terrible! Stop getting 
dragged along by front-runners!" it says.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll write a reply~♪ 
...Are. You. A. Leader.? U. Ra. Ra. Is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Urara-san?! You must not doodle on 
the walls!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's a water-erasable pen, so it's 
okaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It is not okay! 
If you wish to write a reply, please write 
it on a sticky note!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! On top of that shelf... is that a 
vent? 
Extremely suspicious! A clue might be 
hidden in there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even with a stepping stool, I can't quite 
reach... 
I've got it! If I get a running start and 
do a big jump—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: PEGASUUUS—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
STOOOOOP! Climbing is dangerous! Excessive 
jumping and hazardous sprinting indoors 
are strictly prohibited!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on...! E-Everyone...! 
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrgh——

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Urara, Big, Biko, Windy! 
ALL OF YOU, FALL IN RIGHT NOW!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! You are all going too far! 
Dangerous actions are strictly forbidden!! 
Before taking any action, consult with me 
first. Am I understood?!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Yes... 
...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us wrap up today's investigation here. 
Thank you for your hard work, everyone! I 
look forward to working with you tomorrow 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Well, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...The look on their faces... 
Why is this bitterness... welling up 
inside me as well...?)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...No, it's seeping out from my own 
memories. 
...It's the same bitterness... that I 
experienced long ago.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Back when I was in elementary school, 
several classmates started playing soccer 
inside the classroom. 
I explained to everyone that it was 
dangerous, and made them stop.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My father praised me, saying I had done 
the right thing and acted courageously. 
Being praised by the father I respected so 
much made me so happy—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So when I saw a group of adults sitting 
around and making loud noises in front of 
a convenience store, 
I warned them to stop because they were 
bothering the store and other people.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, they readily listened to me. 
However, when my father heard about it... 
he scolded me severely.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand that he scolded me out of 
concern for my safety. 
But at the time, I had expected praise, 
only to be reprimanded...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I was deeply hurt. 
...It felt as though I, as a person, had 
been rejected.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (...Could it be that I...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...have made them feel the exact same way 
I felt back then...?)
